text:
Priya S: Found a GCS object from partner ingestion with an unwrapped service account key and a transit ciphertext together: gs://partner-uploads/prod/2026-05-21/payload.ndjson. Looks like someone stored both plaintext and transit ciphertext in same record. Need containment. @Akshay can you triage?
Akshay: On it. Short triage: 1) quarantine object 2) disable associated SA key 3) mark Vault path as compromised if referenced 4) rewrap ciphertext with new KMS and rotate consumers. Quarantining now.
Todd H: Quick grep: `rg "private_key" gs_partner_dump || true` shows a JSON blob with private_key_id 7e9c4a. Also found a vault path `secret/partners/partnerQ/sa` referenced in metadata.
Akshay: Disabled key 7e9c4a at 2026-05-21T10:12:00Z and deleted after check. Created temp SA redwood-partnerq-temp@project with least-priv, generated key, wrapped with KMS and wrote to `secret/partners/partnerQ/sa.v2`.
Priya S: I ran Vault check: `vault kv get -format=json secret/partners/partnerQ/sa` shows a stored plaintext JSON. Marking compromised and taking read lock.
Platform Team: We'll add a pre-ingest validator to reject uploads containing "private_key" and quarantine them. Short-term hotfix will be a nightly scan. Long-term: require KMS envelope or WIF.
sre-bot: Alert created `vault.reads.partnerQ.anomaly` -> webhook to #incidents. Quarantine job started for object.
Audit: Please collect KMS and Vault audit logs for the window 2026-05-20T22:00:00Z..2026-05-21T10:30:00Z. Also request partner IP list for correlation.
Akshay: Rewrapped affected blobs, rotated cached tokens, restarted ingest workers to pick up `sa.v2`. Adding temporary Vault policy to deny CI runners read access to `secret/partners/partnerQ/*` until smoke tests pass. Will produce postmortem and timeline.
Priya S: Partner notified, CS and Legal looped. Leaving thread open for any anomalous re-reads or KMS unwrap calls. :lock:
